summary: Verified iter34 backend fixes: mixed-feed pool filters test artifacts (bodies 'Case\d+', 'MixedFeedCase', 'list-endpoint-check', 'mixed-feed image', bare '📷') and .test-e2e.com authors; regional pool dedupes by title. All 30 pytest tests in test_editorial_composer + test_wave12_photo_fix + test_wave12_content_sources PASS. Wrote new regression suite test_iter34_feed_filter.py (7/7 PASS) covering artifact filter (default + country=CO), title deduplication, regional priority CO/MX/AR, response shape. Playwright Home check confirms feed cards no longer show Case3/Case4/Case5 as user_post authors and shows regional news/jobs/events/companies with unique titles. Load-more button present, scroll preserved (delta=0), infinite-scroll sentinel absent, see-all buttons (rss/events/suggested-people) all found. NOTE: While the FEED itself is clean, the 'Personas Sugeridas' widget on Home right sidebar still displays test users MixedFeedCase/ListCase/Case5/Case4/Case3 — this comes from a different endpoint (community suggestions/people) that was NOT covered by the current fix but is visually confusing to end users on Home.

integration_issues.issue: Displays test users MixedFeedCase, ListCase, Case5, Case4, Case3 (all appear to be seeded/test community members). Feed cards are now clean per this iteration's fix, but suggested-people list still leaks test artifacts. Likely endpoint: /api/community/suggested-people or equivalent — filter needed to exclude *.test-e2e.com emails and/or names matching /^(Case\d+|MixedFeedCase|ListCase)$/i.

action_items: Apply the same test-artifact filter (email suffix .test-e2e.com and name regex Case\d+/MixedFeedCase/ListCase) to the Suggested People / community suggestions endpoint powering the Home right sidebar widget. Otherwise the visible bug (Case5/Case4/Case3 tarjetas) reported by the user is only partially fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: The dedupe + test-artifact filter logic lives only in content_sources_routes._pool_user_posts / _pool_growth. Consider centralising the 'is test artifact' predicate (email domain, name/body regex) in a shared util and reusing it across ALL public endpoints that surface user-generated data (suggestions, connections, groups, search, etc.) to prevent future regressions.
Better long-term fix: seed/cleanup pytest fixtures so test users/posts are deleted after runs, avoiding the need for runtime regex filters.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The FEED backend fix (mixed-feed) is fully validated: 30 wave12/editorial pytest + 7 new iter34 tests all pass; UI verified via Playwright shows only regional content in feed cards. Remaining issue: right-sidebar 'Personas Sugeridas' widget on Home still surfaces test users (MixedFeedCase/ListCase/Case3/4/5). Once main agent extends the artifact filter to the suggestions endpoint, re-run test_iter34_feed_filter.py and re-take a Home screenshot to confirm the sidebar is clean.
rca of the issue: User-reported bug: Home feed showed test-seed posts (Case3/4/5, '📷', 'mixed-feed image') and duplicated news. RCA: (1) pytest suites inserted user_post rows with these bodies and .test-e2e.com authors that were never cleaned up; the public mixed-feed pool included them. (2) _pool_growth called both LATAM and country queries and concatenated results without dedupe by title, so the same news article showed twice. Fix applied in content_sources_routes.py: _TEST_POST_BODY_RE + email suffix check in _pool_user_posts; title-based dedup in _pool_growth. Repro: GET /api/content-sources/mixed-feed?limit=12 previously included Case5/4/3 user_post items and 'Quién era César Gastelum...' twice. Post-fix: no artifacts, unique titles (verified in test_titles_deduplicated + test_no_test_artifacts_default). Mitigation for the leftover suggestions leak: apply the same predicate to the community suggested-people endpoint.
